MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 您好 (nín hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. You
   B. To be called
   C. Hello (polite)
   D. I, me

2. Which sentence means "And you?"? (1 mark)
   A. 早上好!
   B. 再见!
   C. 我叫小明。
   D. 你呢?

3. What does 妹妹 (mèimei) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Mother
   C. Who
   D. To have, there is

4. What kind of syllable pattern do bàba, māma and dìdi share? (1 mark)
   A. They have only one syllable
   B. They have no vowels
   C. A syllable is repeated
   D. They have three syllables

5. Why is it a good habit to keep household items in their proper places? (1 mark)
   A. It keeps the home tidy and safe
   B. It wastes time
   C. It makes the house noisy
   D. It makes things harder to find

6. What is the Chinese question for "Where is the television?" (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 电视是谁?
   C. 电视有什么?
   D. 这是电视吗?

7. What does 星期二 (xīngqī'èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. Four
   C. Tuesday
   D. Nine

8. What does 星期一到星期五,我上学 mean? (1 mark)
   A. From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   B. Monday is a holiday
   C. I go to school on Saturday
   D. On Sunday, I rest at home

9. Why should we listen kindly when friends explain how they celebrate? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. Only one way is right
   C. Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
   D. It wastes time

10. Which Chinese word means "which number, how many"? (1 mark)
   A. 唱歌 chànggē
   B. 送 sòng
   C. 朋友 péngyou
   D. 几 jǐ

11. What does 葡萄 (pútao) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cooked rice
   B. Beef
   C. Snacks
   D. Grapes

12. What does 饮料 (yǐnliào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. Dinner
   C. Meat
   D. Beef

13. Fill the blank: 我用嘴巴____。 (I use my mouth to speak.) (1 mark)
   A. 看
   B. 听
   C. 说
   D. 摸

14. What does 摸鼻子 mō bízi tell you to do? (1 mark)
   A. Look at your nose
   B. Touch your nose
   C. Cover your mouth
   D. Wash your nose

15. What does 大 (dà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drought
   B. Snow
   C. It rains
   D. Big

16. What does 风 (fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flood
   B. Cloud
   C. Not
   D. Wind

17. What does 旁边 (pángbiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. Fridge
   C. Beside
   D. Table

18. What does 请再说一遍 qǐng zài shuō yí biàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Please sit down
   C. Thank you very much
   D. Please say it once more

19. Which sentence means "Goodbye!"? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢!
   B. 你呢?
   C. 再见!
   D. 我叫小明。

20. What does 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. I, me
   C. Good morning
   D. Goodbye

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin. (3 marks)

22. Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù. (2 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." (2 marks)

24. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!" (4 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?" (2 marks)

26. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea." (2 marks)

27. Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word. (3 marks)

28. Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝. (2 marks)

29. Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences. (4 marks)

30. Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

31. Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #19 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Hello (polite)
   您好 (nín hǎo) means hello (polite).

2. D — 你呢?
   你呢? (nǐ ne?) means "And you?".

3. A — Younger sister
   妹妹 (mèimei) means younger sister.

4. C — A syllable is repeated
   Each word repeats a syllable, with a light second one.

5. A — It keeps the home tidy and safe
   Things in the right place are easy to find and do not cause accidents.

6. A — 电视在哪儿?
   哪儿 is where and takes the place of the answer.

7. C — Tuesday
   星期二 (xīngqī'èr) means Tuesday.

8. A — From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   到 is to, and 上学 is go to school.

9. C — Families celebrate in different ways and all are meaningful
   Respect for different ways of celebrating is important.

10. D — 几 jǐ
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

11. D — Grapes
   葡萄 (pútao) means grapes.

12. A — Drinks
   饮料 (yǐnliào) means drinks.

13. C — 说
   说 is to speak.

14. B — Touch your nose
   摸 is to touch.

15. D — Big
   大 (dà) means big.

16. D — Wind
   风 (fēng) means wind.

17. C — Beside
   旁边 (pángbiān) means beside.

18. D — Please say it once more
   It is a polite way to ask for a repeat.

19. C — 再见!
   再见! (zàijiàn!) means "Goodbye!".

20. C — Good morning
   早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means good morning.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.
